title: BGP: Update for RFC 9830/9831 SR Policy Path attributes dissection
description:
Closes #21255 

Implemented dissection support for BGP Tunnel Encapsulation
Attribute (Type 23), SR-Policy Tunnel Encapsulation (Type 15),
Segment List Sub-TLVs according to RFC 9830 and RFC 9831,
adding all segment types A through K and adds tests for the same.

Add test/suite_dissectors/group_bgp.py covering the BGP Tunnel
Encapsulation Attribute (Type 23) SR Policy sub-TLVs.

New Features:
- Segment Type A: SR-MPLS Label-only SID
- Segment Type B (Type 13): SRv6 SID with optional Endpoint Behavior
- Segment Types C-H: SR-MPLS Node and Adjacency segments with various
  addressing combinations (IPv4/IPv6, Interface IDs)
- Segment Types I-K: SRv6 Node and Adjacency segments with SR Algorithm
  and optional SRv6 SID/Endpoint Behavior

NOTE: For Segment Types I-K and Segment Type B, the RFC 9830, RFC 9831
defines new type values and that has been updated.

Changes:
- Fixed MP_REACH_NLRI next-hop decoding for SR Policy SAFI (73) to
  support both IPv4 and IPv6 next-hops per RFC 9830 Section 2.1
- Corrected Segment List flag bitmasks (V, A, S, B) per RFC 9830 and
  RFC 9831
- Added helper functions dissect_bgp_sr_mpls_sid() and
  dissect_bgp_srv6_sid_endpoint_behavior() to reduce code duplication
- Added support for SRv6 Endpoint Behavior and SID Structure decoding
  per RFC 8986

Reference RFCs:
- RFC 9830: BGP SR Policy SAFI (base specification)
- RFC 9831: SRv6 and Additional Segment Types
- RFC 8986: SRv6 Network Programming (Endpoint Behavior)
- RFC 9552: Interface Identifiers for SR-MPLS

AI-Assisted: yes [Claude Sonnet 4.6]

[sr-policy-bgp.pcap](/uploads/f4f34dbb19e65249e418447f30be357a/sr-policy-bgp.pcap)
